question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    Segment,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS PercentageIncrease
FROM customers_yearmonth
WHERE Currency = 'EUR' 
  AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY Segment
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date,1,4)='2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date,1,4)='2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013
  FROM customers_yearmonth
  WHERE Currency='EUR' AND Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment
FROM c
ORDER BY (c2013-c2012)/c2012 DESC
LIMIT 1
